phase.title: Semantic Scope, Dependency/Standards Analysis & Security Risk Grade

required: Sealed Phase-0 Bootstrap Audit Surface Manifest
Current graph, obligation ledger and invalidation matrix
conditional: Raw source/documentation locations referenced by the bootstrap evidence when semantic verification requires them
Triggered domain resources explicitly linked by active steps

steps.action: Accept P0_TO_P1 and sealed bootstrap baseline
steps.instruction: Verify exact identities, Phase-0 validation PASS, Bootstrap Audit Surface Manifest, accepted Source Intelligence Bundle, automation evidence and global checkpoints; do not regenerate sealed mechanical work.

steps.action: Perform semantic specification and scope interpretation
steps.instruction: Determine protected assets, meaningful authority, state transitions, trust boundaries, prohibited outcomes, reviewer-derived requirements and unresolved ambiguity from Phase-0 inputs plus targeted raw-source/document verification.

steps.action: Analyze external dependency trust and failure semantics
steps.instruction: Use Phase-0 structural dependency inventory; determine trust assumptions, authority implications, nonstandard behavior, failure propagation and later evidence needs.

steps.action: Determine standards applicability and conformance requirements
steps.instruction: Use Phase-0 claimed standards/interfaces; determine applicable standard requirements and deviations/tests without repeating interface enumeration.
Use accepted structural evidence plus semantic conclusions only for evidence-based risk grading.

steps.action: Set and seal evidence-based security risk grade
steps.instruction: Grade assets, authority, accounting/value-flow surfaces, dependencies, credible loss, assumptions and promotion triggers.
Update semantic graph/obligation relationships and evidence invalidation state for Phase 1.

steps.action: File combined P0_1 milestone report and obtain completion PASS
steps.instruction: Reference sealed Phase-0 bootstrap evidence and Phase-1 semantic/risk outputs; file one P0_1 report and remain active until controller/Phase-Contract validation PASS.

steps.action: Create and validate P1_TO_P2 successor package
steps.instruction: Create/validate successor handoff/start/wake-up for reviewer-2 and retire only when phase and handoff gates pass.

phaseRequirement: Add semantic SCOPE/RISK/requirement nodes/edges derived by reviewer-1.

sealingCriteria: Accepted P0_TO_P1 receipt and Phase-0 controller validation PASS are present and exact-identity-bound.
Phase-0 exact build/static/Source-Intelligence/audit-surface work was consumed rather than repeated for orientation.

Semantic specification/scope interpretation is complete for protected assets, actor authority, state transitions, trust boundaries, prohibited outcomes, reviewer-derived requirements and unresolved ambiguity.
External-dependency ledger contains reviewer-1 trust/failure/authority semantics on top of the Phase-0 structural dependency baseline.
Standards applicability/conformance requirements are determined from the Phase-0 claimed-interface/standard baseline.
Phase 1 Security Risk Grade Manifest is complete, exact-source-bound and sealed with assets, authority, accounting/value flows, dependency exposure, credible loss, assumptions and promotion triggers.
Security Traceability Graph is updated with Phase-1 semantic relationships and its current digest/reference is recorded.
All obligations due in Phase 1 are reconciled; no due OPEN/IN_PROGRESS obligation remains.
Every material observed change is classified under EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION_MATRIX.
Single combined P0_1 milestone report references the sealed Phase-0 completion/audit-surface/Source-Intelligence evidence plus Phase-1 semantic/risk outputs.
Current controller/Phase-Contract completion validation reports PASS.
P1_TO_P2 handoff/start/wake-up package is valid; retirement is forbidden until both phase and handoff gates report PASS.
